thread:
maria: Quick question — proposing RBAC change for SIEM S3 export. Current export lives in s3://redwood-logs/siem/raw/ and is encrypted with aws/kms key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/redwood-logs. Proposal: restrict read to siem service account + a small set of auditors via JIT for investigations. Thoughts?

kevin: +1 on JIT. Suggest we create an IAM role redwood-siem-reader and use S3 Access Points per-team to limit prefixes. Also rotate CMK and use grants for temporary access. Example assume-role command: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/redwood-siem-reader --duration-seconds 3600` :thumbsup: 

anita: For retention, I'd propose 90d for exec/sensitive logs (PII-containing), 1y for auth events, 7y for audit trails required by compliance. We should keep hashed identifiers for long-term storage, not raw PII.

dmitri: Concern: current export pipeline stages logs unredacted into the SIEM bucket. Can we add an envelope encryption layer so SIEM only gets encrypted blobs and we manage unwrap keys separately? Also sign events at ingestion so we can detect tampering. :eyes:

infra-oncall: We can add envelope encryption in the exporter — wrap with a dedicated CMK `cmk/siem-envelope`. Also we can implement an Okta-approval step + ephemeral role via AWS STS. I can sketch an automation: on JIRA approval, Lambda issues STS token and writes audit entry.

maria: sketch of lifecycle rule I was thinking:
```
{
  "Rules": [
    {"ID":"sensitive-90d","Prefix":"sensitive/","Status":"Enabled","Expiration":{"Days":90}},
    {"ID":"auth-365d","Prefix":"auth/","Status":"Enabled","Expiration":{"Days":365}}
  ]
}
```

kevin: tiny nit: use object-lock retention for tamper-evidence on audit/ prefix, not full WORM for all. :eyes:

anita: Also we need to log every JIT grant to the central audit log and forward that to SIEM under a separate low-sensitivity stream.

sec-bot: Compliance check: control LOG-RET-01 requires retention mapping and documented access approvals. See https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/Sec/pages/LOG-RET-01

dmitri: Could we add a read-proxy that injects masked fields for analysts? That would let analysts search without exposing raw PII.

infra-oncall: Proxy idea doable. We can use Lambda + API Gateway to serve queries: assume role -> call proxy -> proxy fetches object, applies masking rules (config in SSM) and returns result. All calls logged.

maria: OK, action items: (1) infra to prototype envelope+proxy (dmitri/infra-oncall), (2) security to finalize retention buckets and JIT workflow (anita/maria), (3) eng-platform to create role/redwood-siem-reader + access point (kevin). I'll spin up REDW-4528 and assign. :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll open the PR for the IAM role and S3 access point and link to REDW-4528.

anita: +1, will draft policy language for auditors' justifications.
